title: Contralateral condylar remodeling following unilateral total temporomandibular joint replacement
html: The aim of this study was to investigate the three-dimensional bone remodeling of the contralateral condyle following unilateral temporomandibular joint replacement (TMJR) and to measure the positional stability of the condyle prosthesis postoperatively. The retrospective study included patients who received unilateral total TMJR and underwent computed tomography immediately after surgery (T1) and during long-term follow-up (T2). A total of 17 patients were included, with an average age of 26 (SD 3.6) years.
